description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The facility is committed to providing high-quality care and fostering a positive atmosphere for both residents and employees.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and championing best practices in patient care. We are looking for a leader who can inspire and guide our nursing staff, maintain excellent clinical outcomes, and contribute to the overall success of the facility. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a team that values excellence and compassion.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to step into the vital role of Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This leadership position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to exceptional patient care and operational excellence, working alongside a committed team to uphold the highest standards of nursing practice.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, supporting the Director of Nursing, and ensuring the delivery of compassionate and high-quality care to our residents. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN with leadership aspirations to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. We are looking for a proactive leader who is passionate about nursing and dedicated to fostering a positive and effective care setting.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in nursing.
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory compliance.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $75,000 - $85,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (RN) for a permanent, full-time opportunity at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This role is crucial for maintaining high standards of patient care and supporting our nursing team.

As the Assistant Director of Nursing, you will play a vital role in the leadership team, assisting the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive environment for both staff and residents. We are looking for a committed professional ready to make a lasting impact.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as an ADON
Experience within a skilled nursing facility environment
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center as an MDS Coordinator. In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process, ensuring accurate and timely submission of MDS assessments in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the needs of our residents.This position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about quality care and has a strong understanding of the MDS process. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care in a supportive environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Thorough knowledge of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
Strong assessment, documentation, and communication skills
